The interior of the exhibition hall of Museo leonardiano is designed with stone walls and wooden beams and contains display cases containing ancient tools designed by the genius of Leonardo da Vinci. Hanging from the ceiling are curved instruments made of wood that look like wings. On the walls of both sides there are monitors showing, in an interactive and immersive way, various Leonardo da Vinci's engineering projects.

A group of people riding bicycles along a path in Tuscany, Italy. The background features red poppies and green grasses with cypress trees on both sides. One person is wearing a blue top while another wears white pants. This scene conveys an active lifestyle, summer mood and sense of freedom and adventure.

A group of children wearing chef hats and aprons are sitting at a table. They have their hands working together to make pizza, with happy smiles visible on their faces, creating an atmosphere filled with fun.

A group of baby goats playing in the barn, with one goat chasing another and all standing on yellow straw. One is brown and white, while others have black spots or fur. The scene depicts baby goats playing in a style reminiscent of a barn scene.

Matera, Italy's ancient city with its variations of orange and yellow lights glowing in the evening sky. The view is from above overlooking many buildings and rock structures. There’s an old church tower visible at one end of town. It captures a panoramic view of Matera, which has thousands of houses carved into rocks. In contrast to the golden hues of sunset lighting, it creates a magical atmosphere.
